snippet.description:
Most beginners begin UPSC preparation with one target: clear Prelims. But the exam does not end there. AIR 100 Sattwik Satyakam Devta explains why Prelims, Mains and the Interview demand different skills—and why your preparation method must account for all three from the beginning. A useful starting point for anyone building their UPSC strategy from zero.
